text: {"label":"Sight Word and Spelling Instruction","definition":"Studies teaching individual word reading and spelling, comparing procedures such as incremental rehearsal, prompt delays, picture-text prompts, cover-copy-compare, and mastery criteria for word acquisition and maintenance, often with students with learning disabilities.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Targets acquisition of isolated sight words and spellings, unlike connected-text reading fluency and comprehension, foreign-language learning, or broad literacy curricula and reading-writing assessment."}
